results.detail: Issue ownership, scope_globs and Git state validated.
Derived the seven exact non-evidence paths and this manifest's source digest from the staged Git index.
Checked 313 records, including two v2 records, with zero findings before adding this candidate manifest; final rerun follows evidence creation.
Unsigned local CMake build completed and all three CTest targets passed.

limitations: Equal-loudness processing is a bounded user-space PEQ proxy compiled from caller-supplied formula points; no ISO conformance, licensed table, formal coefficient fit or physical-audio delivery claim.
Strict Direct bypasses the attachment; SceneApply clears it transactionally, but immutable bank crossfade, production epoch/RCU swap and concurrent RT/control validation remain future work.
No IPC schema change, no driver loading, WaveRT streaming, HLK testing or signing progress.
Repository-process and source-only evidence only; digest binds source states but does not provide signed external attestation.
